description: Stable internal ID for one institution across all years and categories (our own, not NIRF's). Built from state + normalised name + NIRF institute_id.
Standardised (canonical) institution name, taken from the broadest category (Overall > University > College > others). Same-name institutions in different states carry the state in brackets.
notes: Use for all charts and filters

description: Institute ID printed by NIRF (2019+ format IR-E-U-0456; older years use other formats).
notes: Optional; many missing for band rows

description: Name exactly as published that year, after whitespace/unicode cleanup.
NIRF ranking year.
Standardised ranking category (Overall, Engineering, Pharmacy, ...).
notes: Filter / facet. Never add up or average across categories: the same institution is listed in several categories in one year

description: Category label as published on the source page.
General (Overall, University, College, Research, ...) vs Discipline (Engineering, Pharmacy, ...).
Cleaned city (no 'District', PIN/sector numbers or trailing state; Gurgaon->Gurugram, Calcutta->Kolkata, ...).
City as published.
Standardised state/UT name (e.g. Orissa -> Odisha). It is the location of that year's listing.
ISO 3166-2:IN two-letter state/UT code (TN, KA, DL, ...).
notes: Join key for state GeoJSON / choropleth

description: State as published.
Exact NIRF rank (1 = best). Null when rank_status is band, not_published or withdrawn. Ties share a rank.
rank if exact, otherwise rank_midpoint of the band. Use when every institution needs a number (mobility, improvement, volatility).
notes: Banded rows are approximate (+/- half a band)

description: exact = published rank; band = listed only in a rank band; not_published = listed with no rank (Innovation 2023); withdrawn = 'Rank Withdrawn'; inferred_from_score = rank missing in the source but the score fits exactly one free slot in the published sequence.
notes: Filter on this instead of testing rank for null

description: Rank text exactly as published (e.g. '21A', 'Rank Withdrawn').
Lower bound of the rank (equals rank for exact ranks; start of the band for banded rows).
Upper bound of the rank (equals rank for exact ranks; end of the band for banded rows).
True if the institution is listed only in a rank band (no exact rank, score or parameters).
Band as 'low-high', e.g. '101-150' or '201-250'.
'derived': the band starts after the last exact rank of that year+category; pages '...150' then '...200'; width = institutions on the page rounded to 25.
notes: Verify a few bands on nirfindia.org

description: (rank_low + rank_high)/2. Filled for exact ranks and for bands.
NIRF overall score (0-100) for that category and year. Null for band rows and a few small categories.
Teaching, Learning & Resources score (0-100).
Research and Professional Practice score (0-100). Called 'RP' in older years.
Graduation Outcomes score (0-100).
Outreach and Inclusivity score (0-100).
Perception score (0-100).
Weights (%) of TLR/RPC/GO/OI/PR in the score for that category and year, estimated from the data (R2 = 1). E.g. 30/30/20/10/10.
notes: Scores are only strictly comparable under the same scheme (see score_weights_estimated.csv)

description: rank <= 10 within its category and year.
rank <= 50 within its category and year.
rank <= 100 (banded rows count only if the whole band lies within 100).
First year the institution appears in that category (excluding the category's first year).
First year the institution appears in that category.
First year the category exists in the data (e.g. Dental, Innovation start later than 2017).
Number of categories published that year (6 in 2017, more later).
Source file / page name the row was taken from.
